text:
ana: heads up seeing a bunch of auto-fallbacks during bursty quota events. operators are manually undoing them but there's no quick way to preview safety impact.

mike: agreed. proposal: add a safety-leash preview that simulates "what-if" rollback effects for 1 minute sampling. quick UI arrow chart and a text blurb.

sasha: important: any manual undo must create an immutable audit entry with the operator identity and a reason code. also we should prevent undo if it violates SLA constraints.

quentin: +1 on audit entries. we should also surface machine-readable fallback reason codes (e.g., Fallback::RateQuota, Fallback::ModelOOM, Fallback::KVCacheMiss) so downstream tooling can react.

dev-bot: CI: rollout-safety-leash - integration tests queued

ana: (typo) ana: rough API draft for operator undo with preview:

POST /v1/rollouts/{id}/preview-undo
{
  "preview_seconds": 60,
  "simulate_metrics": true
}

Response: a small summary with estimated error delta, latency delta, and a list of top-3 affected routes.

POST /v1/rollouts/{id}/apply-undo
{
  "reason_code": "operator:quiet_bump",
  "comment": "brief note",
  "ttl_secs": 600
}

mike: question: is ttl_secs additive to existing rollout TTLs? define precedence. also server should enforce a max ttl (suggest 1h) and concurrent undo limit (1 active per route).

sasha: enforcement: block apply-undo if (current_error_rate - baseline) > 0.05 AND latency_increase > 20%. safety first.

quentin: UX: overlay the preview with a small traffic split graphic and a confidence band. also show the last 5 fallback events that led to the current state. ops need context.

ana: telemetry: attach trace ids + 3 anonymized request samples and an error-class histogram to the audit log. link the preview id so we can replay later in debug tools.

mike: backend: we can run the preview in a branch of the routing engine against a sampled stream (10%) to estimate. need an opt-in for heavy tenants to avoid cost.

sasha: doc/security: only roles with rollout:operator may apply-undo. preview can be read by rollout:viewer. record IP and session id in audit. retention 365d for customer-facing incidents, 90d for general ops.

dev-bot: ticket created: OPS-3321 (safety-leash preview + operator undo schema)

quentin: next: ana to mock overlay and copy, mike to stub server checks and sampling harness, sasha to write the audit schema and IAM rules. i'll own SDK + docs.

ana: i'll add an experiment plan that compares time-to-recover and number of unnecessary rollbacks when preview offered vs not. small A/B across some routes. :bar_chart:
